name: powershell-automation
description: Create PowerShell automation scripts for IT operations
request_pattern: Create PowerShell automation scripts for: ${task_description}. Include: parameter validation, error handling with try/catch, transcript logging, progress bars for long operations, credential handling via Get-Credential (never hardcode), idempotent operations where possible, and a README with usage examples.

variables.task_description: automated server health checks across multiple machines with HTML report output
